_comment: VOICE MODE (VHF-high rail). Airspy R2 keeps doing P25 (LRGVRRS); the RTL-SDR is added as a SECOND source tuned to the ~161 MHz rail band and feeds a CONVENTIONAL FM system. Rail calls flow into the same pipeline as P25 (VAD -> Opus -> transcribe -> enrich -> feed) and appear in the call feed as 'Railroad'. Switch in/out with scripts/sdr-mode.sh voice|adsb|acars. NOTE: in this mode the RTL is NOT doing ADS-B or ACARS. NOAA (162.400) is intentionally excluded (continuous broadcast would flood the feed) -- use a SAME alert monitor instead.

sources._comment: Airspy R2 — P25 trunked (unchanged from airspy-only).

RTL-SDR on the VHF-high rail band. 2.4 MS/s (multiple of 24000) centered at 160.98 MHz covers 159.78-162.18 MHz -> all rail channels below. analogRecorders (not digital) for conventional FM. Bump gain if signals are weak.

systems._comment_system: RGV railroad — conventional FM. Channel order = TG id (1..N) in rail-talkgroups.csv. 160.740 UP42 road (Brownsville Sub), 161.115 Rio Valley Switching (local shortline), 160.410 UP20, 161.355 UP83 IL, 161.400 UP86 IL, 161.550 AAR97. Tune squelch so only real transmissions record.
